arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, random
U = 1 << 128
rng = random.Random(7)

def addr_txt(i):
    h = format(i, '032x')
    return ':'.join(h[t:t+4] for t in range(0, 32, 4))

initial = [[addr_txt(i << 112) + '/128', 1] for i in range(32)]
tx = [[['set', addr_txt(i << 112) + '/128', 2] for i in range(20)]]
bursts = []
for b in range(256):
    v = b % 2
    rep = rng.choice([1, 10, 1000000])
    addrs = [addr_txt(rng.randrange(64) << 112) if rng.random() < 0.5 else
             addr_txt(rng.randrange(U)) for _ in range(32)]
    bursts.append({'version': v, 'repeat': rep, 'addresses': addrs})
caseA = {'initial': initial, 'transactions': tx, 'bursts': bursts, 'cache_pages': 12,
         'costs': {'hit': 1, 'miss': 256, 'decode': [16, 8, 0]}}
open('/workspace/tmp/tests/stressA.json', 'w').write(json.dumps({'cases': [caseA]}))
print('A bytes:', len(json.dumps({'cases': [caseA]})))
EOF
time timeout 170 python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py < /workspace/tmp/tests/stressA.json > /workspace/tmp/tests/stressA.out
python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/tests/stressA.out'))
c = d['cases'][0]
print('objective:', c['objective'])
print('versions:', len(c['versions']), 'R:', [len(v['starts']) for v in c['versions']])
print('answers ok:', all(len(bb)==32 for bb in c['bursts']))
print('img sizes:', [len(v['image'])//2 for v in c['versions']])
